Plastic Discovered In More Than 50% of Plaques From Clogged Arteries

“Plastics are now everywhere, with tiny fragments found in several major organs of the human body, 

In March, a small study in Italy found shards of microplastics in fatty deposits surgically removed from patients who had an operation to open up their clogged arteries – and reported their health outcomes nearly 3 years later.

Following 257 patients for 34 months, the researchers found nearly 60 percent of them had measurable amounts of polyethylene in plaques pulled from their fat-thickened arteries, and 12 percent also had polyvinyl chloride (PVC) in extracted fat deposits. 

PVC comes in both rigid and flexible forms, and is used to make water pipes, plastic bottles, flooring, and packaging. Polyethylene is the most commonly produced plastic, used for plastic bags, films, and bottles, too.

With microplastics previously found coursing through people’s bloodstream, the researchers were reasonably concerned about heart health.

“Observational data from occupational-exposure studies [also] suggest an increased risk of cardiovascular disease among persons who are exposed to plastics-related pollution, including polyvinyl chloride, than that seen in the GENERAL POPULATION,”

Why Hijrah! WARNING – 10: How can this Ummah REGAIN the DIGNITY and raise above the humiliation that Kuffar has inflicted them with?

Bismillah 
Al Hamdulillah 
AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah 

What is Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil?
How does understanding this issue separate the Haqq from the Baatil?

Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil.
The solution for this Ummah to revive its dignity.

Aal-e-Imran 3:110

كُنتُمۡ خَيۡرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخۡرِجَتۡ لِلنَّاسِ تَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَتَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَتُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِۗ وَلَوۡ ءَامَنَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَكَانَ خَيۡرࣰا لَّهُمۚ مِّنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمُ ٱلۡفَٰسِقُونَ 

“You are the best nation produced [as an example] for mankind. 
You enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and believe in Allāh.” 

“If only the People of the Scripture had believed, it would have been better for them. Among them are believers, but most of them are defiantly disobedient.”

Let’s do a critical analysis of the first part of this Ayah.

Allah endorsed Muslims as the best nation among others. 

(1)

How best?
What kind of best? 
Is there any specific explanation to understand this ‘best’?

Ahmad, At-Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah, and Al-Hakim recorded that Hakim bin Mu`awiyah bin Haydah narrated that his father said that Rasulullah Sallillahu A’laihi Wa Sallam said,

«أَنْتُمْ تُوَفُّون سَبْعِينَ أُمَّةً، أَنْتُمْ خَيْرُهَا، وَأَنْتُمْ أَكْرَمُ عَلَى اللهِ عَزَّ وَجَل»

“You are the final of seventy nations, you are the best and most honored among them to Allah.”

So, we now have more specific knowledge from authentic sources as to how best this Ummah of Muhammad is. (Sallallahu A’laihi Wa Sallam)

(2)

So, what makes this Ummah of Muslims best than all other Ummah?

If you read the next phrase of the Ayah after Allah mentioned Muslims as the best nation, He, A’jja Wa Jalla mentioned ‘Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil.’

So, we can derive the understanding that what makes Muslims as best nation is Enjoining Good and Forbiding Evil.

(3)

Then, what is Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil?
The Ayah doesn’t say that. The next phrase moved to another subject.
Then, how do we understand what Allah actually meant by saying ‘Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil’?
By following the Quran and the Sunnah or by following our HAWA?

(4) Know the Misguidance – the Astray Scholars

Aren’t we supposed to approach to understanding of the Quran and Hadith in the following ways?: 
What did Rasulullah say about it, or how did he practice it?
And what did the Sahaba understand, and how did they implement it?
Subsequently, we look at the Salaf as to how they understood it and approached it.
If we don’t find anything even there, we consider what is commonly understood by the Ulama.
This is our general approach to understanding the Quran, right? 

And this is what every group claims that they follow the Quran, Sunnah and the understanding of the Sahaba and the Salaf. Yet, we found it many times, in reality, most of them follow their Hawa. 

And each of these groups preaches that you cannot derive an understanding of an Ayah or a Hadith isolately, you must give it a holistic approach, which is true only about a few cases/ issues, but they use the cases of a few universally, to the entire Quran and Hadith. 

Yet, we found it many times in reality, most of them follow their Hawa, deriving a Sharia ruling from one Ayah of the Quran.

(5)

I challenge you, go, find and read everything about this issue of ‘Enjoining Good and Forbiding Evil’ from the academic scholarship of today’s modern Ulama, you won’t find the real understanding of ‘Enjoining Good and Forbiding Evil’ as it is understood by the Sahaba.

This is because most of these modern-day Ulama with academic scholarships at their disposal are living ‘happily ever after’ under the Kuffar’s Sharia’ in the Kuffar’s land.

And most of these modern-day Ulama having big titles by their names like ‘Mufti’, ‘Grand Mufti’, etc. are also living ‘happily ever after’ under the same Kuffar’s Sharia’ by endorsing the Taghut, those who are implementing the Kuffar’s Sharia’ on the Muslims, in the Muslim-majority lands, in the Muslim’s own lands. Therefore, they explain this Ayah from their desire, what suits their master, the Kuffar and the Taghut.

(6) Dignity Being Muslim

But now, let us take you to the understanding of the Sahaba about what and how they really understood ‘Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil’. 
Wa Ma Tawfeeqee Illa Billah. 

Al-Bukhari recorded that Abu Hurayrah commented on this Ayah, 

 بَاب :{كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ} مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوْسُفَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيْ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ (كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ) قَالَ خَيْرَ النَّاسِ لِلنَّاسِ تَأْتُوْنَ بِهِمْ فِي السَّلَاسِلِ فِيْ أَعْنَاقِهِمْ حَتَّى يَدْخُلُوْا فِي الإِسْلَامِ 

“(You, Muslims) are the best nation of people for the people, you bring them tied in chains on their necks and they later embrace Islam.” 
(Saheeh Bukhari 4557)

Subhanallah!
This is not only an explanation of an Ayah as what is understood by a Sahaba.
Rather, this is the only solution for the entire Ummah.
This is where the dignity of Muslims lies, in the power and strength to chain the Kuffar to make them obey Allah’s Sharia’ 

(7)

So now, we have to explain this Hadith.

What does it mean by ‘bring them in chains till they embrace Islam’, when there’s no force in Islam?
Does it contradict Allah’s word, “La Ikraha Fi deen” (There’s no force/ compulsion in Deen)

Definitely, there’s no force in Islam, and this Hadith also says the same in different wordings. Embrace Islam here means, obey Islam, meaning, they must abide by Islamic Sharia’. They can follow their Deen privately, in their homes, but they must obey (here ‘Dakhala’, means embrace) Islamic Sharia’, pay Jiziya to Islamic authorities.

(8) ‘Muslims’ OBEYING Kuffar’s Sharia’

Subhanallah!  
This is exactly what the Kuffar are doing now to the Muslims, exactly the opposite.

What they are saying (by their actions) is that ‘You Muslim can practice your Deen, by going to Hajj, pray Salah (we will give away our churches for that, no problem), observe Siyam (we will invite you to our white palace for Iftar, no problem) but you must obey our ‘Sharia”, you must pay us Jiziyah (Tax)

So, how do they say it?
How do they make Muslims obey their Sharia’
‘If there’s a case of killing, you can’t judge the issue by your Allah’s Sharia’, you must submit to our Sharia’.’
‘If there’s a stealing issue, you can’t judge that by your Allah’s Sharia’, you must submit to our Sharia’.’
‘If there’s a Zina (rape) issue, you can’t judge that by your Allah’s Sharia’, you must submit to our Sharia’.’
‘If there’s a Zina issue (cheating on you by mutual consent), you can’t judge that by your Allah’s Sharia’, you must submit to our Sharia’.’
‘If there’s a family violence, you can’t judge that by your Allah’s Sharia’, you must submit to our Sharia’ and we will give freedom to your wives’ Ha Ha Ha!
And so on!

Yes, , What Muslims are now doing, Obeying Kuffar’s Sharia’, paying Jiziyah to the Kuffar in the form of taxes, doing the opposite they are supposed to do.
La Hawla Wa La Quwata Illa Billah! 

And Yes! Our women, those who took the Kuffar as their Rabb, for any dispute with their husbands, they turn to the Kuffar’s Sharia’ so quickly to earn their ‘freedom’ that the Kuffar ensure under their Sharia’!
Allahu Musta’n.
May Allah protect our women.
May Allah guide our women to submit to Allah’s Sharia’!
Ameen.

(9)

So, that’s about women in only women-related issues. 
But today, the Ummah of Muslims willingly and wholeheartedly obeying and submitting to the Kuffar’s Sharia’.

And this matter of obeying Kuffar’s Sharia’ became so easy to this last few generations of Muslims that it is not enough that they are forced by the Kuffar in their homeland, where they might have an excuse in front of Allah for obeying Kuffar’s Sharia’ (while Allah Subhanahu repeatedly warned Muslims not to obey the Kuffar)
But they even come, settle and submit directly and willingly under the Kuffar’s authority to show their submission to Kuffar’s Sharia’ and paying Jiziyah (tax).
Inna Ilaihi Wa inna Ilaihi Rajiun.

(10) Know Your STATUS, O Muslims

This is the status of the Muslims today.
Shirk of obeying other than Allah’s Sharia’ has been made easy for them.

Yet they are ‘happily living ever after’ directly under Kuffar’s authority, building Masjid, doing Dawah work, thinking they are the ‘best nation’ doing ‘Enjoying Good and Forbidding Evil’ by distributing pamphlets and raising their next generations as ‘the foam/ froth/ scum of the sea’, while Kuffar has kept them under their feet, humiliating them, disgrace them in the east, in the west, in the north, in the south, in the morning, in the evening, one entire nation after another entire nation.

Only because they left the understanding of the Quran as the way the Sahaba really understood it. Instead, they follow their Hawa.

And Allah knows best.
May Allah save Muslims from these misguided scholars who made it a normal thing to live under the Kuffar and the Taghut.

I call the Muslims to reject those misguided ‘Ulama’ and live by the dignity of being Muslim, work to bring Islamic authority, and move away from the Kuffar’s authority. 

Wa Allahu A’lam.
May Allah guide us.
May Allah save us from the humiliation of the Kuffar.
May Allah strengthen us.
May Allah give victory to the Muzahideen.
May Allah make our Hijrah easy.

Why Hijrah! WARNING – 12: A Holistic approach to Hijrah – Do you follow part of the Quran by disregarding Allah’s command to eat only Tayyib (PURE and BENEFICIAL) food?

:|: A Holistic approach to Hijrah – As Allah commanded, we are supposed to eat only Tayyib (PURE and BENEFICIAL) food. :|:

:|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|:
:|: Quran for Critical Reasoning :|:
:|: Quran Study – One Ayah a Day :|:
:|: Time for Hijrah! :|:
:|: Hijrah Made Easy :|:
:|: Why do you have to think about Living off-grid? :|:
:|: Know the Corrupt Minds :|:
:|: At Least Know shaitan :|:
:|: Dignity Being Muslim :|:
:|: Enjoining Good and Forbidding Evil :|:
:|: Muslims Abandoned the Quran – Abandoned the Wahee :|:
:|: Following a ‘Package Islam’ – a Root Cause of Disaster of the Ummah :|:

Bismillah
Al Hamdulillah
Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’la Rasulillah!

(1)
Food of human being: ‘Halal and Tayyib’ (حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا)

Aujubillahi Min Asshaitwanir Rajeem.

Surah Al-Baqarah (2:168-173)
يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ كُلُوا مِمَّا فِي الْأَرْضِ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
“O mankind, eat from whatever is on earth [that is] Halal (lawful) and Tayyib (pure/ beneficial ) and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.”

Subhanallah!
Let’s do a Critical Reasoning of the Ayah here.
What did Allah commanded the people?
To eat from ‘Halal and ‘Tayyib’ food.

(2)
The Ummah that cling only with ‘Halal’ but no regard to Tayyib:

Subhanallah! We Muslims know what is Halal.

When it comes to Halal food, every single Muslim possesses a PhD-level knowledge, Ma Shaa Allah! The concern for Halal food engraved in a Muslim’s mind so much that even a sinning Muslim while engaging in Haram things look for Halal meat.

But when you ask such Muslims about ‘Tayyib’ food, they have little or no understanding. They possess no certain knowledge about it. The astonishing fact is that Muslims even show no concern about what is Tayyib as if Allah’s word stops at Halal only. La Hawa La Wa La Quwata Illa Billah! There’s no regard whatsoever about Tayyib that would make you think Allah’s word has no value to a Muslim. Allahu Musta’an.

Question is, why has that happened? How’s that happened?
How a Muslim gives no importance to Allah’s word?
The reason is deep, out of the scope of the topic of this Article.
If I have to mention very briefly here, it would be like this:
Muslims have been following a ‘Package Islam’ by abandoning the Quran, abandoning the Wahee for a long time.
En Shaa Allah, we will discuss this issue in a proper place.
So, let’s move now to understand ‘Tayyib’ food in the Ayah.
Wa Ma Tawufiqi Illa Billah!

(3)
What’s the place of ‘Tayyib’ in regards to food?

What does it mean to eat ‘Tayyib’?
General meaning, good, pure food and food that benefits you.

But what about Allah’s command of eating the ‘Halal Food’?
First of all, when it comes to the matter of food, Allah Ajja Wa Jalla didn’t only mention the word ‘Halal’ rather, He Al-Hakeem also mentioned ‘Tayyib’ (pure and beneficial) with that. (Examples: Surah Al-Baqarah 2:168, Surah An-Nahl 16:114)

What does it mean?
It means, in regards to food, ‘Halal’ is only one part of the condition of food that are allowed. There is another condition attached to it, which is, that it has to be ‘Tayyib’ as well.

(4)
How important is this condition of food to be “Tayyib’?

The matter becomes such important that if you read other Ayat regarding food, you will find Allah only mentioned about ‘Tayyib’, not even the word ‘Halal’. Such as

“O believers! Eat from the Tayyib (PURE and BENEFICIAL food) we have provided for you. And give thanks to Allah if you ˹truly˺ worship Him ˹alone˺.”
(Surah Al-Baqarah (2:172):

And then, read this Ayah:

فَٱبْعَثُوٓا۟ أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ أَيُّهَآ أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًا فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا

“So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is ‘Zaka’ Taw’ama’ and bring you provision from it.”
(Surah Al-Kahf 18:19)

Look at the food the people of the cave was looking for. It’s ‘Zaka’ (أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًۭا), which means again, the pure/ beneficial food. Not mentioning ‘Halal’.

And then look at the another Ayah where Allah mentioned only ‘Tayyib’ in regards to Rizq, not even the word ‘Halal’


وَٱذۡكُرُوٓاْ إِذۡ أَنتُمۡ قَلِيلࣱ مُّسۡتَضۡعَفُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ تَخَافُونَ أَن يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ فَآوَىٰكُمۡ وَأَيَّدَكُم بِنَصۡرِهِۦ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
“And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with pure/ beneficial provisions -(وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ) that you might be grateful.”
(Al-Anfal 8:26)

Subhanallah!
What do you understand from these Ayat?
These Ayat didn’t even mentioned ‘Halal’?
Just only Tayyib or ‘Zaka’
What does this suggest?
Tayyib is like a replacement/ alternative/ similar condition of a food to be Halal.
In other words, whatever is Tayyib that is Halal or whatever is Halal that has to be Tayyib.
A Haram food cannot be a Tayyib food, A food which is not Tayyib cannot be Halal.

(5)
Something to be Halal has to be Tayyib:

Subhanallah!
The critical reasoning of the above Ayat is proven by another Ayah where Allah Al-Hakeem straight away clarified the meaning of Halal as Tayyib:


يَسْأَلُونَكَ مَاذَا أُحِلَّ لَهُمْ قُلْ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ وَمَا عَلَّمْتُم مِّنَ الْجَوَارِحِ مُكَلِّبِينَ تُعَلِّمُونَهُنَّ مِمَّا عَلَّمَكُمُ اللَّهُ فَكُلُوا مِمَّا أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ

“They ask you, [O Muhammad], what has been made ‘Halal’ for them? So eat of what they catch for you, and mention the name of Allah upon it, and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.’”
(Surah Al-Ma’idah 5:4)

Yet Allah’s word doesn’t impact Muslims, so we have to look for scientific evidence to prove the corruption of the food system! So here it is!

(11)
The corruption of the food system could be understood by just one horrible findings:

Report 1:
70% of the food on the shelves is corrupted:
https://mightypursuit.com/blog/the-rise-of-disease-greed-inside-the-global-corruption-of-the-food-industry/

Report 2:
Humans Living in Cities Are Slowly Losing Their Ability to Digest Plants.
https://www.msn.com/en-au/health/other/humans-living-in-cities-are-slowly-losing-their-ability-to-digest-plants/ar-BB1k8s1i?ocid=msedgntp&pc=U531&cvid=ec7a22c5e24849019b606c79f31cb978&ei=424

And here is a research about how corrupted the entire food chain has become:

1. Processed and Ultra-Processed Foods
Modern diets are dominated by processed foods laden with artificial additives, preservatives, refined sugars, and unhealthy fats.

Scientific Findings: A 2019 study published in BMJ linked ultra-processed foods to an increased risk of cardiovascular disease, obesity, and type 2 diabetes. These foods are often high in sugar, salt, unhealthy fats, and artificial additives while lacking essential nutrients.

Source: Srour, B., et al. (2019). ‘Ultra-processed food intake and risk of cardiovascular disease: prospective cohort study (NutriNet-Santé). BMJ’.

2. Chemical Contamination (Pesticides, Antibiotics, etc.)

Antibiotics and Hormones:
Pesticides: The Environmental Working Group (EWG) publishes an annual “Dirty Dozen” list highlighting produce with the highest pesticide residues. Studies have linked pesticide exposure to health issues like cancer, neurological disorders, and hormonal disruptions.

Antibiotics in Livestock:
Livestock is often treated with antibiotics and growth hormones, which can enter the food chain and contribute to antibiotic resistance and hormonal imbalances in humans.

The World Health Organization (WHO) has warned that the overuse of antibiotics in animal farming contributes to antibiotic resistance, a major global health threat.

Source: WHO (2017). ‘Stop using antibiotics in healthy animals to prevent the spread of antibiotic resistance’.

3. Genetically Modified Organisms (GMOs)
The results of most studies with GM foods indicate that they may cause some common toxic effects such as hepatic, pancreatic, renal, or reproductive effects.
Scientific Findings: Organizations like the FDA and WHO, concerns remain about the long-term environmental and health impacts of GMOs

For example, a 2015 report by the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) classified glyphosate (a herbicide used with GMO crops) as “probably carcinogenic to humans.”

Source: IARC (2015). ‘Glyphosate Monograph’.

4. Food Adulteration
Adding harmful substances to food (e.g., melamine in milk, artificial colours in spices, or diluted olive oil), compromises safety and quality.

Scientific Findings: A 2018 report by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) found that a significant percentage of food samples tested were adulterated, including milk, spices, and edible oils. Adulterants like melamine, artificial colours, and harmful chemicals pose serious health risks.

Source: FSSAI (2018). ‘National Milk Safety and Quality Survey’.

5. Loss of Nutritional Value
Scientific Findings: A 2004 study published in the Journal of the American College of Nutrition found that Soil depletion from intensive modern farming practices has led to a decline in the nutrient content of crops. Fruits and vegetables today often contain fewer vitamins and minerals compared to those grown decades ago.

For example, the study reported a 6% decline in protein content and a 38% decline in vitamin B2 levels in vegetables over 50 years.

Source: Davis, D. R., et al. (2004). ‘Changes in USDA Food Composition Data for 43 Garden Crops, 1950 to 1999’.

6. Lead poisoning and health: Heavy Metals:
Heavy metals, microplastics, and other pollutants contaminate water and soil, entering the food chain. Seafood, for example, is increasingly affected by microplastics and mercury.

The World Health Organization (WHO) reports that heavy metals like lead and cadmium in food and water can cause severe health issues, including kidney damage and developmental problems in children.

Source: WHO (2021). ‘Lead poisoning and health’.

So now, you know what’s going on, what food you’re eating.

(Surah Nahl 16:128)

(Surah Al-Ankabut 29:69)

And you must believe when Allah says:
“And whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out and provide for him from where he does not expect. (Surah At-Talaq 65:3):

Indeed, unless you have a firm belief in Allah’s words and unless you have the attitude to stand against the the corruption, you will always be a subject to the corruptors.

On the other hand, when you have a firm belief in Allah’s word and you have the attitude to stand against corruption, for you Allah will be sufficient. As Allah promised:

Bismillah! Al Hamdulillah!
Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah!

(1)
UNDERSTANDING OF A SIMPLE MATH:

2 + 2 always makes 4. It’s a simple math. A kid understands that.
Once a kid knows that simple math he follows that in his entire life.
But how about then after knowing this simple math an adult does not understand this or when he understands this simple math but doesn’t follow it?

It’s only when his mind is unstable.
And usually when a man’s mind becomes unstable?
It’s when he is in a drunken state.

(2)
EVERYTHING HAS ITS OWN PLACE:

Allah placed everything in its proper place, everything in its perfect balance. Al Ar-Rahman said,

(1) ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
(2) عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
(3) خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ
(4) عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
(5) ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
(6) وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
(7) وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
(8) أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
(9) وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ

(1) The Most Merciful
(2) Taught the Qur’ān,
(3) Created man,
(4) [And] taught him eloquence.
(5) The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
(6) And the stars and trees prostrate.
(7) And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
(8) That you not transgress within the balance.
(9) And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

In all Allah’s creation, everything has its place, everything Allah, Al-A’leem, the Most Knowledgeable put in balance. If something is not in its proper place, it loses its life, it becomes lifeless and soulless, thus losing its balance.

The open air and the blue sky are the places for the birds. They can’t live in the sweet water of the river or the salty water of the ocean. Such is true about fish. The open air and the blue sky are not for the fish, water is their place.

(3)
DIGNITY BEING MUSLIM

Allah made us Muslims, Al Hamdulillah.
Allah Ajja Wa Jalla gave us dignity by making us Muslims.
And that dignity comes from observing Allah’s balance.
Living in a proper place is the basic criterion for observing that balance.
Therefore, we Muslims must live in our proper place to live by that dignity.

(4)
You’re a Muslim.
A Muslim has many regular rituals to do, which come very normal to him.
He does those Islamic things naturally and habitually.
He does those acts of Ebadah on a daily basis without thinking, hesitating, or intimidating.

That’s degrading yourself as a Muslim! That’s degrading Islam.
It’s a simple Math!

Giving Salam to a Muslim is a normal thing even to a regular Muslim.
In fact, it is the right of a Muslim over another Muslim to give Salam in any encounter with his Muslim brother. Our Ulama even says It’s an obligation (Wajib) for a Muslim to give Salam.

But when you live in a place/ workplace where you can’t give Salam to a Muslim, that can’t be your place.
That’s degrading yourself as a Muslim! That’s degrading Islam.
It’s a simple Math!

Isn’t that the case with Muslims working in the corporate offices in the Kuffar’s lands?

Example 2:

When you live and work in a place where you can neither call the Adhan nor hear it and you lack the courage to do so, instead you find a narrow and dark corner, designated by your management so ‘favourably’ and you finish your Salah as quickly and quietly as possible, while you try your best not to be noticed by anyone, that’s for sure, can’t be your place.
O Allahi, that’s degrading yourself as a Muslim! That’s degrading Islam.
It’s a simple Math!

Isn’t that the case in the corporate workplaces in the Kuffar’s lands where you feel intimidated calling Adhan?

Example 3:
When you live in a place where you can’t pray 5 daily Salah in Jama’a even though you have 3 Muslims in the same office room, in the same building in your workplace/ neighbourhood, for sure, that can’t be your place.
That’s degrading yourself as a Muslim! That’s degrading Islam.

Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said,
“If three people in a town or in the desert do not establish prayer among them, then Satan wraps them.“
(Sunan Abu Dawud 547, Saheeh)

Example 4:

That’s degrading yourself as a Muslim! That’s degrading Islam.

In fact, these Muslims are like ‘the froth/ foam of the sea’, whose heart is attached to Dunya, no matter where they live. They are the ‘Muslims’ in Kuffar’s Mindset, who grabbed Kuffar’s Deen so dearly. May Allah guide them.

May Allah guide Muslims.
May Allah guide these ‘scholars’.

So read!

The STORY of the Muslims who settled in the Kuffar’s land in the past

(Translated from Arabic)
Written by Mu’minah Al-A’zam
Granddaughter of the late Sheikh Ali Al Tantawi
(May Allah have mercy on him).

“O those who travel to the West… The Western environment will not have mercy on your children and grandchildren.”

“My grandfather, Ali Al Tantawi, was wise enough to prevent us from going through with our immigration process to Canada when it was proposed and available to us at the time. Our children were still young back then. I was skeptical about his reasoning, whilst my ego as a young parent made me jump to the assertion that he was too strict and only wanted to control his children’s life… May Allah have mercy on him…”

“Now I tend to agree with him and recall his wise decision whenever I come across a story of people whose children have lost their Deen, in the midst of the busy life in the West. His reasoning was: “To choose to live in the land of kufr leads to losing your offspring. If you are able to protect your children, you can never guarantee to protect their children and their grandchildren. Do not carry the responsibility [of their losing their Deen].”

“I remembered all of that when I came across a post by a friend:

A precautionary tale

“Someone told me today, “If I had enough money I would immigrate to America instead of Turkey. It will never affect me or my family where I immigrate, what’s important is how I raise my children and not where I raise them.”

I had to warn him that the choice of the place is considered one of the fundamentals of raising (Tarbiyya) the children.

It is said, ask the experienced over the wise. So here is my experience:

Nine years ago I was tasked to investigate the family history of the Ramadan family (a Beirut family). I began with the family tree and searched (online) for all the family members all over the world. I found 5000 members and the statistics were staggering. Here’s a list of those in the family that migrated to the West:

Those who migrated
– 100 years ago: 96% of their offspring are NOT Muslim
– 80 years ago: 75% of their grandchildren are not Muslim
– 60 years ago: 40% of their grandchildren are Christian
– 40 years ago: 25% of their grandchildren left Islam

Around 80 years ago a ‘Sheikh’ migrated to Ecuador and built the first masjid there. He insisted on raising his children upon Islam. Today none of his grandchildren is Muslim. This is the case of most families.

Personally, among the 48 of my grandfather’s grandchildren, 16 are not Muslim. We live in the United States, and I have been an American Citizen for 40 years.

In Ecuador, there are 98 of the Beirut’s Ramadan family. The Ramadan forefathers migrated there in 1923. Now all of the 98 grandchildren are Christian. I met George, Christian and Emilio Ramadan. I managed to convince Emilio to come to the family union in Adana, Turkey after I offered him financial assistance only for him to learn about the Muslim history of his family. It was really heartbreaking.

These statistics are not the same among the families that migrated to an Islamic country.
=================
The End.
=================

A REFLECTION:

Now, take a pause from whatever level of Deen you’re doing.
You might be the one doing the highest level of good deeds, doing heaps of Sadaqah Jariah such as building Masjids, doing Dawah work, converting people to Islam, engaging in much Islamic community work, putting your children in the Islamic school, giving them Islamic environment, making them become Huffaj, and thinking you’re doing best and you often ask yourself, ‘what else can I do?’

Obey Rasulullah.
Obey his warning:

“I disown those who settle among the Mushrikeen.”
(Sunan Abu Dawud 2645. Saheeh)

And then, you need to do just ONE act of ‘Nahi A’nil-Munkar’ (forbidding evil) on yourself, and that is,

Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said,
“Whoever institutes an evil practice in Islam will have its sin and the sin of those who act upon it without diminishing their sins at all.”
(Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim 1017)

So, do you think your all Dawah work would outweigh the OUTCOME of following your desire and not obeying Rasulullah’s warning?

Do you think your all Sadaqah Jariah would outweigh the OUTCOME of your grand and grandchildren’s children going out of Islam until the end of the world?

Why Hijrah! WARNING – 07: Allah’s earth is spacious, therefore, you must move away from submitting to the ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’!

:|: Time For Hijrah :|:
:|: Al-Wala Al-Barra :|:
:|: Reject Kuffar’s Deen, Reject ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’ :|:
:|: Quran for Critical Reasoning :|:
:|: Quran Study – ONE Ayah a Day :|:

Bismillah!
Al Hamdulillah!
Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah!

Al-‘Ankabut 29:56

يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَرْضِى وَٰسِعَةٌ فَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱعْبُدُونِ

“O My believing servants! Surely, my earth is spacious, so worship Me ˹alone˺/ worship only Me.“

Bismillah
Al Hamdulillah
Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah

Let’s do a Critical Reasoning (contemplate) – (Primary Level) on the Ayah

What are the subjects here?

  • (1) Earth
  • (2) Worship

What is said about these subjects?

  • (1) It says Allah’s land is spacious, land is vast. That’s easily understandable.
  • (2) And worship Allah alone.

What does it mean to 'worship Allah alone'?

Well, this means worshipping Allah without Shirk.
This is what is expected from those who call themselves Muslims.
Which is why Allah sent his messenger.
Which is why He sent the Quran.
I think that’s also easily understandable by every Muslim.

But why did Allah put these two issues together?
What’s the interrelation between these two issues?

We can derive a simple understanding that Allah, the owner of the land, confirms that there is Allah’s land where Muslims can worship Him without Shirk because He says, ‘My earth is spacious’ in relation to worship Him alone.

Another point is, since this Quran is the guide for humanity until the last day, therefore, there will always be such a land until the end of the world where Muslims would be able to worship Allah without Shirk, without submitting to ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’.
And that’s a certain knowledge we can derive from this Ayah.

Critical Reasoning (contemplate) – (Intermediate Level):

We can also derive an implied meaning that Allah orders his servants that when living in a land becomes such that you cannot worship Allah Subhanahu Wa T’ala alone (without Shirk, without submitting to a law other than Allah’s Law), you must move away from that land and go to a land where you can worship Allah without Shirk.

So, when and in what circumstances does a land become a state where you cannot worship Allah alone?

We will understand that when we would know the implications of what it means to ‘worship’.
Let’s try to understand that, En Shaa Allah!

So, what does worship mean?
Simply put, it is to obey Allah, to do what Allah ordered us to do and to stay away from what He forbade us from doing.

And these two things are summarised and given the Islamic terms, which we know as
‘Deen of Allah‘ and ‘Sharia' of Allah‘.

Therefore, let’s ask ourselves these simple questions:

(1) Does following Allah’s Deen mean worshipping Allah?
Yes!

Then, can someone claim that he worships Allah alone when he also submits to a Deen other than the Deen of Allah?
No!

(2) Does following Allah’s Sharia’ mean worshipping Allah?
Yes!

Then, can someone claim that he worships Allah alone when he also submits to a Sharia’ (unless forced) other than the Sharia’ of Allah?
No!

Does it now give some idea why Allah mentioned these two separate issues together?

When you cannot follow Allah’s Deen in a land, you have to move to a land where you can follow Allah’s Deen.
When you cannot follow Allah’s Sharia’ in a land, you have to move to a land where you can follow Allah’s Sharia’.

Or you can say this in the opposite way, which is,
When you are subjected to follow 'Kuffar's Deen' in a land, you have to move out from that land to a land where you can follow Allah’s Deen.
When you are subjected to obey ‘Kuffar's Sharia‘ in a land, you have to move out from that land to a land where you can follow Allah’s Sharia’.

But we always hear “Where’s that land?“
Is there a land where Allah’s Deen is followed?
Is there a land where Allah’s Sharia’ is implemented?

Well, this question has two implications.
If this question means you want to know something that you have no knowledge of, then it is something normal.
And in that case, we invite you to join us in that quest, if you are really sincere.
And here is the Telegram link:

Click here to join

WhatsApp Link:

https://chat.whatsapp.com/L1eMBUns0rqDc5kYCXeHmv

But if you are posing these questions as a challenge that there’s no such land exists where you can follow Allah’s Deen, then these questions could be the words of Kufr.

How do you say that?
Well, you’re denying something that Allah Ajja Wa Jallah Himself confirms in the Quran.
Since Allah says, “Allah’s land is vast”, in respect to worshipping him alone, then, there must be a land and there will be a land until the Qiyamah, where you don’t have to submit to the Kuffar’s Deen, to the Kuffar’s Sharia’! And that’s the Certain Knowledge for a Muslim.

And Allah knows best.
May Allah save us from following ‘Kuffar’s Deen’.
May Allah protect us from obeying ‘Kuffar’s Sharia”.
May Allah make our Hijrah easy.
Ameen.

(13) لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ

Why Hijrah! WARNING – 03: How important it is to move away from living among the Mushrikeen?

:|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|:
:|: ‘Muslims’ Following Kuffar’s Deen :|:

Bismillah!
Al Hamdulillah!
Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah!

How important is the matter of not living with the Mushrikeen?
How important are the words of a person what he speaks as the last advice before his death?
These are such important words that even these words get a legal status, in case you don’t know it.

Then, what about the instructions of Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam on his deathbed?
How important could that be for the Ummah?
For sure, It is the most important legal binding on the Ummah, the most important Shariah of Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam.

So, what was the last message of Rasulullah at the last moments of his death?
“Expel the Mushrikeen from the territory of Arabia.”

Subhanallah!
Why did this matter become such important to Rasulullah?
It’s because He was concerned about his Ummah so much that he wanted to give a final prescription, and the final Shariah for his Ummah to stay on the right path!

So, he prescribed, “Do three things so that you won’t go astray”
And the first instruction was this:
“Expel the Mushrikeen from the territory of Arabia.”

What’s the meaning of it?
It means he did not want his Ummah to be among the Mushrikeen or
He did not want the Mushrikeen around the Muslims.
Because he knew that living around the Mushrikeen would lead them to go astray, lead them to engage in Shirk, the greatest sin of all.

And what do you see today?
How many Muslims and Muslim kids take part in one way or another in the pagan rituals of Halloween, Santa, and Christmas rituals?
How many Muslim youths in Bangladesh, Pakistan, Malaysia, and Indonesia take part in Hindu pagan rituals?
And soon the Muslims of the Arabian peninsula would engage or take part in these rituals as the present authorities of the kingdoms allowing the Mushrikeen to build their worship places in the lands of Islam.

So, no wonder, why won’t you see the Muslims gone astray today?
They are not only living among the Mushrikeen, rather they are living under the authority of the Mushrikeen! (In the Kuffar’s land and then, whoever it applies to)
Thus we are witnessing the consequences that Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam warned about.

Let’s cite a few of such scenarios here:

Scenario 1:
This author himself witnessed a business house owned and run by Muslims, decorated with Christmas decorations during this festival of Shirk.

Scenario 2:
An 11-year-old girl asks her parents to put a Christmas tree in the house, And the Jaheel parents ask Fatwa about it:

That’s why it is so important to move away from living under the authority of the Mushrikeen and from living among the Mushrikeen, saving yourself and your generations from Shirk.

And Allah knows best.
May Allah protect us from going astray.
May Allah save us from living among the Mushrikeen.
May Allah make our Hijrah easy.
Ameen.

Here is the full text of the Hadith:
Saheeh Muslim 4124 (20/1637)

Sa’id b. Jubair reported that Ibn ‘Abbas said:
Thursday, (and then said): What is this Thursday?
He then wept so much that his tears moistened the pebbles.
I said: Ibn ‘Abbas, what is (significant) about Thursday?

He (Ibn ‘Abbas) said:
The illness of Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam took a serious turn (on this day),
and he said:

“Come to me, so that I should write for you a document that you may not go astray after me.”
They (the Companions around him) disputed, and it is not meet to dispute in the presence of Rasulullah.
They said:
How is (Rasulillah)?
Has he lost his consciousness? Try to learn from him (this point).

He (Rasulillah) said:
“Leave me. I am better in the state (than the one in which you are engaged).
I make a will about three things:
Turn out the polytheists from the territory of Arabia;
show hospitality to the (foreign) delegations as I used to show them hospitality.”

He (the narrator) said: He (Ibn Abbas) kept silent on the third point,
or he (the narrator) said:
But I forgot that.

This hadith was mentioned through another chain.

—
Also in Saheeh Bukhari 3053 stated:
Rasulullah on his death-bed, gave three orders saying,
“Expel the pagans from the Arabian Peninsula”

Also in Saheeh Bukhari 4486 stated:
It has been narrated by ‘Umar bin. al-Khattib that he heard Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said,
“I will expel the Jews and Christians from the Arabian Peninsula and will not leave any but Muslim.”

Please note:
There is another hadith (Saheeh Muslim 4126) narrated from a different chain that doesn’t say Rasulullah Sallallahu Alahi Wa Sallam was able to write because of interference from Umar Radiallahu Anhu.

But how do we reconcile these Hadiths?
By the intention of Rasulullah and later the actions of the Sahaba.
We know from history that no Mushrikeen were allowed to live in the Arabian peninsula.
Therefore, the implementation of the Hadiths itself proves the authenticity of these Hadiths mentioned above.
And Allah knows best.

باب تَرْكِ الْوَصِيَّةِ لِمَنْ لَيْسَ لَهُ شَىْءٌ يُوصِي فِيهِ ‏‏ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ – وَاللَّفْظُ لِسَعِيدٍ – قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ،

قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ
وَمَا يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ
ثُمَّ بَكَى حَتَّى بَلَّ دَمْعُهُ الْحَصَى ‏.‏
فَقُلْتُ يَا ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَمَا يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ قَالَ
اشْتَدَّ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَعُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ

‏”‏ ائْتُونِي أَكْتُبْ لَكُمْ كِتَابًا لاَ تَضِلُّوا بَعْدِي ‏”‏ ‏.‏
فَتَنَازَعُوا وَمَا يَنْبَغِي عِنْدَ نَبِيٍّ تَنَازُعٌ ‏.‏
وَقَالُوا مَا شَأْنُهُ أَهَجَرَ اسْتَفْهِمُوهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏”‏

دَعُونِي فَالَّذِي أَنَا فِيهِ خَيْرٌ أُوصِيكُمْ بِثَلاَثٍ أَخْرِجُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ مِنْ جَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ
وَأَجِيزُوا الْوَفْدَ بِنَحْوِ مَا كُنْتُ أُجِيزُهُمْ ‏”‏ ‏.‏

قَالَ وَسَكَتَ عَنِ الثَّالِثَةِ أَوْ قَالَهَا فَأُنْسِيتُهَا ‏.‏
قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ،

قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ

Why Hijrah! WARNING – 05: You don’t help the Kuffar in killing and oppressing Muslims and plotting against Islam.

:|: Basheera Wa Nazeera :|:
:|: Is Allah Not Your RABB? :|:
:|: ‘Muslims’ Obeying Kuffar’s Sharia’ :|:

Bismillah
Al Hamdulillah
Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah

Allah said, “DO NOT obey the Kuffar.“
(Al-Furqan 25:52)

But you?
You are not only obeying, you’re submitting yourself to Kuffar’s Sharia’ .

Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said,
“Whoever takes arms against us, he is not from us“
(Saheeh Bukhari 6874)

But you?
You’re part of the Kuffar’s oppression in killing of Muslims and you’re aiding the Kuffar in plotting against Muslims.

And Allah said the consequence of obeying the Kuffar:

“They will turn you back on your heels, and you will [then] become losers“.
(Ale Imran 3:149)

For sure, you really are in a dangerous situation, those who are living and settling under Kuffar’s authority.
You are involved in two major crimes.
Obeying, submitting yourself to the ‘Kuffar's Sharia‘.
And following ‘Kuffar's Deen‘.

And knowingly or unknowingly helping Kuffar in killing and oppressing Muslims, and aiding them in plotting against Islam.

These crimes could be accounted for as Kufr.
Allahu A’lam.
Let me explain.

(1) Submitting to Kuffar’s Deen:
This is already explained.
If you would like to know, please click this link:

(2)
And knowingly or unknowingly helping Kuffar in killing and oppressing Muslims and aiding them in plotting against Islam:

How do you get involved in it?
To get to a clear understanding of this, let’s do a Critical Reasoning of this Hadith.

Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said,
“Whoever takes arms against us, he is not from us“
(Saheeh Bukhari 6874)

Who is Rasulullah talking about here, A Kafir?
No! A Kafir is already not ‘from us’.

Then, who else is He talking about?
A Muslim.
When a Muslim takes arms against the Ummah of Muslims, he doesn’t belong to Islam anymore.

How does this issue relate to Hijrah?
Well, it does. Let me explain.

The one who helps commit a crime, is he also guilty of the crime?
Yes!

The one who helps in murder, is he also guilty of murder?
Yes!

Then, those who fight Muslims, aren’t aiding them also means fighting along with them?
You do the math!

Let me put it in a way so that a 13-year-old can understand the issue easily.
There’s a million-dollar masjid project.
You give only $10 Sadaqah.
Why?
Expecting Sadaqah Jaariah, continuous reward of your portion of $10.
Expecting Allah will reward you abundantly.
Thinking, maybe just this Sadaqah would be a cause of your saving from Jahannam.

So, put this scenario in your portion of the Tax that these Kuffar governments use for.
These are the money that governments use to maintain their state affairs, right?
Isn’t it then easy to understand that you get a proportionate share of all the evil they do against Muslims and against humanity? The propagation of Zina, alcohol, gambling and whatnot and the example of LGBTQ is just before your eyes right now.

Is there any doubt that you will get a proportionate share of all these evils?
And then, what about their forces that fight against Muslims?
Where do those campaigns get funded from?
What about their secret forces that are relentlessly plotting and propagating against Islam?
Who funded those organisations?
It is from the tax money that they collect from their people, and you have a proportionate share in that.

That’s how you are helping them in killing and oppressing Muslims.
That’s how you’re aiding them in plotting against Islam.
And that’s how this Hadith applies to you: you carry arms against Muslims.
Allahu A’lam.

Therefore, calculate your status.
You do the math.

I know, you don’t give up yet. You might be thinking, ‘I am just a victim of the system.
I didn’t choose to live in this system. I was born in this system. What can I do?

Well, think this way, a Kafir is also born in a Kuffar family.
Can he place his argument  in front of Al-Hakeem on the day of judgement, “I was just a victim, I was born in a Kafir family, you put me in a Kafir family”

You know that this won’t work.
He has to seek the truth and then, when he finds the truth, he has to change his entire lifestyle to claim his Jannah, to save himself from Jahannam.
He sometimes has to go through challenges such as leaving his own family, friends, and society. Can you even imagine the plight of those new Muslims?
And your situation is not worse than the newly reverted Muslims. You know it.

Remember this: there are millions of oppressed Muslims out there raising their hands against the oppressors, and for sure, you’re aiding those oppressors through your tax money while Allah instructed you to stand by the side of your oppressed brothers and do Jihad against the oppressors. But you, one way or another, are knowingly or unknowingly aiding those oppressors.

Therefore, you have only one way out of this calamity.
Hijrah!
Hijrah, away from obeying and submitting to the ‘Kuffar’s Sharia’ and away from aiding the Kuffar in their oppression of Muslims.

My brother, It’s time for Hijrah!
May Allah not make us among those who aid the Kuffar in oppressing and fighting the Muslims.
May Allah make our Hijrah easy.
Ameen.
